spec.name: M7.QueryRebase.reparameterization
spec.statement: ∀ (H N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (moves : Fin H → M7.Action.Record N), (∀ x : M7.GlobalQuery.Index H N, M7.QueryRebase.undo moves (M7.QueryRebase.reparam moves x) = x) ∧ (∀ x : M7.GlobalQuery.Index H N, M7.QueryRebase.reparam moves (M7.QueryRebase.undo moves x) = x) ∧ Function.Bijective (M7.QueryRebase.reparam moves)
queries: finite group action inverse composition bijection
spec.guidance: Unfold the explicit right-composition and undo with inverse. Use actual accepted Action.associative, right_inverse, left_inverse and right_identity, plus product equality. Prove injectivity and surjectivity from the two explicit inverse identities. No abstract assumed action is used. Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target and default limits.

spec.name: M7.QueryRebase.realize_reparam
spec.statement: ∀ (H N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (bases : M7.GlobalQuery.Family H N) (moves : Fin H → M7.Action.Record N) (x : M7.GlobalQuery.Index H N), M7.GlobalQuery.realize (M7.QueryRebase.rebase bases moves) x = M7.GlobalQuery.realize bases (M7.QueryRebase.reparam moves x)
queries: finite group action inverse composition bijection
spec.guidance: Unfold rebase, reparam and GlobalQuery.realize; this is exactly actual Action.act_compose, oriented symmetrically. Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target and default limits.

spec.name: M7.QueryRebase.sector_base
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (q : M7.DefaultQuery.Query) (base placed : M7.Action.Recipe N) (g : M7.Action.Record N), (M7.DefaultQuery.sectorTest q (M7.Action.act g base) placed ↔ M7.DefaultQuery.sectorTest q base placed)
queries: finite group action inverse composition bijection
spec.guidance: Split sectorMode. Placement-sector is identical. Class-sector existential records reparameterize by h ↦ compose h g. Reverse direction chooses compose h (inverse g), using associative, left_inverse/right_inverse, right_identity and act_compose. Keep the literal full signature predicate; no signature transport or distance-invariance theorem is required. Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target and default limits.

spec.name: M7.QueryRebase.feasible_objective
spec.statement: ∀ (H N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (q : M7.DefaultQuery.Query) (bases : M7.GlobalQuery.Family H N) (moves : Fin H → M7.Action.Record N) (x : M7.GlobalQuery.Index H N), (M7.GlobalQuery.feasible q (M7.QueryRebase.rebase bases moves) x ↔ M7.GlobalQuery.feasible q bases (M7.QueryRebase.reparam moves x)) ∧ M7.GlobalQuery.objective q (M7.QueryRebase.rebase bases moves) x = M7.GlobalQuery.objective q bases (M7.QueryRebase.reparam moves x)
queries: finite group action inverse composition bijection
spec.guidance: Use literal realization equality from realize_reparam. Unfold GlobalQuery.feasible/objective and DefaultQuery.feasible; every placement-dependent term is identical. Only the class-sector base changes, handled by sector_base. This retains caps, NoLogical policy and all objective coordinates without class-label invariance assumptions. Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target and default limits.

spec.name: M7.QueryRebase.winners_reparam
spec.statement: ∀ (H N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (q : M7.DefaultQuery.Query) (bases : M7.GlobalQuery.Family H N) (moves : Fin H → M7.Action.Record N) (x : M7.GlobalQuery.Index H N), x ∈ M7.GlobalQuery.winners q (M7.QueryRebase.rebase bases moves) ↔ (M7.QueryRebase.reparam moves x) ∈ M7.GlobalQuery.winners q bases
queries: finite group action inverse composition bijection
spec.guidance: Use verified GlobalQuery.winners_exact on both families, feasible_objective on each competitor, and surjectivity of reparam from reparameterization to transport the universal global comparison. Competitors span every class/action index; no per-class-optimum shortcut. Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target and default limits.

spec.name: M7.QueryRebase.winning_classes
spec.statement: ∀ (H N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (q : M7.DefaultQuery.Query) (bases : M7.GlobalQuery.Family H N) (moves : Fin H → M7.Action.Record N), M7.GlobalQuery.winningClasses q (M7.QueryRebase.rebase bases moves) = M7.GlobalQuery.winningClasses q bases
queries: finite group action inverse composition bijection
spec.guidance: Use verified GlobalQuery.winning_classes membership equivalence. reparam preserves the class index definitionally and is bijective; undo also preserves it. Transport every winning action, keeping all tied class indices. Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target and default limits.

spec.name: M7.QueryRebase.winner_images
spec.statement: ∀ (H N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (q : M7.DefaultQuery.Query) (bases : M7.GlobalQuery.Family H N) (moves : Fin H → M7.Action.Record N) (placed : M7.Action.Recipe N), ((∃ x ∈ M7.GlobalQuery.winners q (M7.QueryRebase.rebase bases moves), M7.GlobalQuery.realize (M7.QueryRebase.rebase bases moves) x = placed) ↔ ∃ x ∈ M7.GlobalQuery.winners q bases, M7.GlobalQuery.realize bases x = placed)
queries: finite group action inverse composition bijection
spec.guidance: Transport witnesses by reparam and its explicit undo, using winners_reparam and realize_reparam. This is equality of physical winner-image sets, not equality of redundant action encodings. Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target and default limits.

spec.name: M7.QueryRebase.presentation_images
spec.statement: ∀ (H N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (q : M7.DefaultQuery.Query) (bases : M7.GlobalQuery.Family H N) (moves : Fin H → M7.Action.Record N) (placed : M7.Action.Recipe N), ((∃ x : M7.GlobalQuery.Index H N, M7.GlobalQuery.present q (M7.QueryRebase.rebase bases moves) x ∧ M7.GlobalQuery.realize (M7.QueryRebase.rebase bases moves) x = placed) ↔ ∃ x : M7.GlobalQuery.Index H N, M7.GlobalQuery.present q bases x ∧ M7.GlobalQuery.realize bases x = placed)
queries: finite group action inverse composition bijection
spec.guidance: For each family, presented physical images equal winning physical images: present implies winner by definition; conversely apply verified GlobalQuery.same_class_presentation to any winning index and use its realizing equality. Then use winner_images. Least action indices may change after rebasing, so only the actual physical-image sets are equated. No separation/coverage/full-transversal hypothesis is needed. Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target and default limits.
